company.shortDescription: Reflex provides an adaptive game-based math fact fluency program for students in elementary and middle grades.
company.description: Reflex provides an adaptive, game-based math fact fluency program that focuses on addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division for students in grades 2 and above. The platform delivers assessment, coaching, and practice through online games that adjust to each learner’s current skill level. It uses a fact family approach and research-based instructional methods to build automatic recall of basic math facts. Reflex includes management tools for teachers and parents, such as student rostering, usage tracking, and detailed fluency growth reports. Educators can use it for core instruction, intervention, or remediation, including for students who are at risk or have special needs. Features like Reflex Competitions and in-product rewards support ongoing engagement while progress data helps guide instructional decisions.
